# ABC7 New York (WABC Eyewitness News)

> > ABC7 New York is the flagship ABC television station serving New York City, Long Island, New Jersey, and the greater tri-state area with breaking news, weather, and local coverage.

WABC-TV Channel 7 Eyewitness News delivers comprehensive local journalism covering NYC, New Jersey, Long Island, and surrounding communities. The station features specialized content including AccuTrack weather radar, trending stories, investigative reporting through 7 On Your Side, and coverage of major events like the FIFA World Cup 2026.

## Core News & Weather Services

- [AccuTrack Radar](https://abc7ny.com/weather/doppler/accutrack-radar): Live AccuTrack Doppler weather radar for NYC & greater New York area
- [The Trend](https://abc7ny.com/thetrend): Trending stories and viral content hub from Eyewitness News Channel 7
- [Eyewitness News Extra Time](https://abc7ny.com/thecountdown): Daily news analysis program covering NYC politics and current events

## Investigative & Consumer Reporting

- [NJ Transit Problems Investigation](https://abc7ny.com/post/nj-transit-addresses-what-is-being-done-problems-7-side-investigation/18706898): 7 On Your Side investigates NJ Transit delays and cancellation problems
